annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2103 of 30 July 2024 on harmonised standard for direct remote identification for unmanned aircraft drafted in support of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2103 of 30 July 2024 on harmonised standard for direct remote identification for unmanned aircraft drafted in support of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision publishing, with restriction, the reference of harmonised standard EN 4709-002:2023 on direct remote identification for unmanned aircraft systems in the Official Journal, giving a presumption of conformity with Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 except for reception by existing mobile devices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reference of EN 4709-002:2023 is published in the Official Journal with restriction.
Standard gives presumption of conformity with Delegated Regulation 2019/945 requirements, except specified points.
Restriction: standard does not cover broadcast signal being receivable by existing mobile devices.
Decision enters into force on the day of publication.
